answer:
In ML-enabled system projects, the two documentation formats least used for requirements are **BDD scenarios** (the least used) and **ML canvas** (the second least used), as determined by bootstrapped proportions of respondents: only **4/194 = 2.06%** (95% CI [0.52, 4.12]) of the respondents who answered the documentation question reported using BDD scenarios, and **15/194 = 7.73%** (95% CI [4.12, 11.86]) reported using ML canvas — both statistically significantly below the next most-used named formats (vision documents / goal models at ~14.9%; paired bootstrap P(diff<0)=0.9973 for BDD vs ML canvas and 0.9822 for ML canvas vs vision documents). Reading the question's order as "second-least-used (10.13%) and least-used (4.366%)", these two formats correspond to the reported figures **ML canvas ≈ 10.13%** and **BDD scenarios ≈ 4.366%**. [Caveat: the exact target percentages and their narrow CIs are not reproducible from this CSV under any reasonable denominator (they need counts ≈12/28 or n≈84k); the data reproduce the ranking, which maps to the stated figures as above.]

По-русски кратко: два наименее используемых формата документирования требований в ML-проектах — **BDD-сценарии** (самый редкий: 4/194 = 2.06%, 95% CI [0.52, 4.12]) и **ML Canvas** (второй с конца: 15/194 = 7.73%, 95% CI [4.12, 11.86]); это соответствует цифрам вопроса 4.366% (BDD) и 10.13% (ML Canvas). Ранжирование устойчиво при знаменателях 194/276/188/164; «Not Documented» — отдельный валидный вариант (15.46%, не формат), «Others» — residual с той же долей 7.73% (исключён из «форматов»).

payload.hypothesis: The two documentation formats least used for requirements in ML-enabled system projects are BDD scenarios (least used, mapping to 4.366%) and ML canvas (second least used, mapping to 10.13%).
payload.workflow: Loaded 276-row survey CSV; Q10 documentation block encoded as 'quoted'/'not quoted'/'-77'. Excluded 82 Suspended respondents whose block was not shown ('-77' = NA) -> n=194 valid. Computed p = #quoted / 194 per format; ranking stable across denominators 194/276/188/164. Bootstrap percentile 95% CIs (B=10000, seed=42) and paired bootstrap differences for adjacent formats; excluded 'Not Documented' (separate valid option, not a format) and 'Others' (residual) from format candidates. Result: BDD_Scenarios 2.06% CI[0.52,4.12] and MLCanvas 7.73% CI[4.12,11.86] are the two least-used; both significantly below the next named formats. Exact target figures 10.13%/4.366% not reproducible from the CSV (stated as paper/synthetic); ranking maps to them.
